verdict.rationale: Crossmint's public pricing page lists wallet pricing (1,000 free monthly active wallets, then $0.05 per MAU), which plausibly covers agent wallets. It also says checkout, onramp, and offramp carry per-transaction fees on tiered pricing, but gives no numbers. The evidence states plainly that no agent-card or agent-checkout price is published, so a merchant cannot fully price agentic channels without asking sales. Missing for 10: published per-transaction fees for agent cards and agent checkouts, concrete checkout fee rates instead of unquantified tiered pricing, and clarity on who bears agent-transaction fees.
